Author: anentrypoint <admin@coas.co.za>

    prd: the page smoke never drives the fullscreen flow
    
    Expansion pass over the delivered hero-select work found one verification
    gap worth a row: page-smoke proves the lobby mounts, the console stays clean
    and the hero atlas loads, so a lock-in that drops every click still ships
    green. Filed rather than fixed, since the smoke's own run is CI-side work.
    
    File created by hand: this session has no gm-mcp transport, so prd-add was
    not available.

diff --git a/.gm/prd/flow-smoke-never-clicks-the-hero-select.yml b/.gm/prd/flow-smoke-never-clicks-the-hero-select.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..4045b1c3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.gm/prd/flow-smoke-never-clicks-the-hero-select.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+id: flow-smoke-never-clicks-the-hero-select
+subject: the CI page smoke never reaches the hero grid, so a broken lock-in ships green
+description: >-
+  scripts/perf/page-smoke.mjs waits for the lobby, for no console errors and
+  for the hero icon atlas, but it never drives the fullscreen flow: team card,
+  hero grid, lock-in, team orientation. The lock-in shipped dead (onHero
+  passed startFlowMatch a name where the function reads hero.type, so the type
+  guard dropped every click) while every gate stayed green, and the grid's
+  three attribute columns, the team filter and the five-stands-a-side
+  orientation view are likewise only covered by a local DOM run. Give the
+  smoke a flow pass against the built page.
+acceptance_criteria: >-
+  The smoke clicks a team card, asserts the hero stage shows three labelled
+  attribute columns whose counts sum to the roster, presses one hero and
+  asserts the orientation stage presents two sides of five stands with the
+  local pick marked; the run fails when the lock-in does not start the match.
+  A green run cites the run id for its full 40-character sha.
+witness_plan: >-
+  Separate-session witness dispatches ci.yml on main and reads the page-smoke
+  job result from the Actions API with the full sha.
+session_id: drain-pages
+owner: drain-pages
+status: pending
+note: >-
+  Filed by hand during the 2026-10-27 drain: this session has no gm-mcp
+  transport, so prd-add was unavailable; the schema mirrors the open row
+  beside it. The feature itself is shipped and covered by a local DOM run
+  (three-column split, team filter, lock-in, five stands a side) plus the
+  CI smoke's lobby, console and icon checks.
